title: Not structured like the picture
text: Not structured like the picture. There is no structure to this bag so the tree sort of just flops around inside.  It reminds me of parachute material which is probably very strong but without the structure around the contents, I am just wondering if it will really be protected.  I have the box that the tree came in and I will likely just put it back in the box since that has more protection than this bag provides.  Disappointed.
